drawings.description: figure : le treillis des drapeaux pour $n = 2$. En haut $D_{012}$ ; de lui descendent des flèches vers $D_{01}$, $D_{02}$, $D_{12}$, marquées « épi » ; de ceux-ci vers $D_0$, $D_1$, $D_2$, la flèche $D_{02} \to D_1$ barrée d'une croix, et « épi » sur plusieurs flèches
drawings.notes: Redrawn on a tight crop. D012 on top, D01, D02, D12, then D0, D1, D2, with "épi" twice at the right. The three strokes from D012 have no visible arrowheads and are drawn as plain strokes; of the lower ones only D01 -> D1 carries a head. D02 -> D0 is one line drawn in two pieces (the upper piece forms a caret with the stroke from D02 towards D1), D12 -> D1, a short stroke from D12 towards D2. The only cross on the crop is a long stroke crossing a stroke that runs from below D12 down to the right, towards the foot of D2: it is not on the arrow D02 -> D1 where the transcription puts it; which arrow that crossed stroke is (perhaps D1 -> D2 or D12 -> D2) is a reading. Left out: a small struck mark between D0 and D1 and a small 4-like mark after D01, the line "D01 épi !!" above the lattice with its arrows and long underline (text of the page). Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.disagreement: The cross of the transcription's « la flèche D02 -> D1 barrée d'une croix » stands on the crop on a stroke running from below D12 down towards D2, not on D02 -> D1.

drawings.description: figure centrale : le même treillis dessiné plus grand, $D_{012}(F)$ en haut, $D_{02}(F)$, $D_{12}(F)$, puis $D_{01}$, $D_0$, $D_1$ et une case $\lbrace 1 \rbrace$ ; au-dessous une petite échelle encadrée « 2 3 4 5 ». À droite, un carré $D_{012} \to D_{12}$, $D_{02} \to D_2$, puis deux segments dessinés, l'un avec un point milieu, et « 23 ? »
drawings.kind: lattice of flags drawn larger; square; two segments
drawings.notes: Redrawn on a tight crop. Left: D_I above; D012(F) on top, D02(F) and D12(F), then D01, D0, D1 and {1} (read with its braces, as the transcription has it); "épi" beside the arrow from D012(F) to D12(F). Strokes where they stand: a long stroke from D012(F) down to D01, a short one to D02(F), an arrow to D12(F) and a small point between them; under D02(F) two short strokes (no target); arrows from D12(F) down to D1 and to {1}, a third arrow into {1} from the left, a short arrow D01 -> D1, a stroke D01 -> D0 and a short stroke beside D0. The ladder "2 3 4 5" is framed by a heavy bar above and a bracket below and at the left (not a closed box). The separating stroke, then at the right the square D012 -> D12, D012 - D02, D12 - D2, D02 -> D2, and the two segments with end ticks, the second with its point near the middle and its left half heavy; "2 3" and "?" under them. Still a reading: the targets of the short strokes under D02(F), which arrows carry heads (most strokes end without one). Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: figure : un diagramme à deux étages. En haut $R_1'$, avec des flèches vers $F_0'$ et $F_1'$ ; de $F_0'$, $R_1'$, $F_1'$ descendent des flèches vers $R_1$, $F_0$, $F_1$, $F_2$ ; $R_1$ s'envoie sur $F_0$ et $F_1$. Le même diagramme est répété plus bas pour le cas 4), précédé de « $F_0$ »
drawings.notes: Upper diagram: R1' with arrows to F0' and F1'; from F0', R1', F1' strokes down to R1, F0, F1, F2; R1 -> F0, F1. Lower diagram, the same for case 4), with "4)" and "F0" above it; a small mark like "A" before F2 is left out. Short strokes without heads are drawn as on the page. The three small diagrams 1), 2), 3) at the top left of the sheet (3) heavily struck) are not part of this mark and are not drawn.

drawings.description: figure : un graphe, deux sommets cerclés reliés par une longue arête ; au premier pendent trois arêtes courtes ; le second, cerclé en bas, porte deux arêtes marquées d'un point milieu et une arête vers un troisième sommet cerclé, d'où partent trois arêtes formant un fuseau
drawings.kind: graph with ringed vertices and a spindle
drawings.notes: A ringed vertex with three short pendant edges, joined by a long arc to the right; a ringed vertex below carries two edges marked by a middle point and an edge (also with a middle point) to a vertex from which three edges form a spindle ending in a third ringed vertex at the top right. On the page the spindle starts from an unringed vertex and ends in the ringed one (the transcription puts the ring at the start).
